summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its consolidated financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026, as originally filed with the Argentine Securities Commission (CNV). The filing includes statements of income, comprehensive income, and capital structure details, but no mention of any M&A transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation. The registrant is simply reporting routine quarterly financial results. No special-situation classification applies.
